methodology: Analytical sensitivity d(Pcu)/d(Re) at fixed terminal U is proportional to |Zother|^2-Re^2, before current/X limits.
Pulse overlap integrated exactly within dt; ensures equal nominal duty and avoids phase-boundary aliasing.
Two parallel Euler Cauer states are driven by Pcu(T) or constant cold Pcu under same command and same simulation duration, with comparison truncated if either reaches 200K.
warnings: No measured thermal parameters, no calibrated U/I or real voltage/current waveforms.
Model 200K termination is an extrapolation limit, not failure physics.
Ideal X peak/current envelopes have not been implemented/validated in miniDSP.
No true music spectra, power-compression changes to BL/Cms/Le, dynamic class-D thermal foldback.
